fields.Area: Caster and up to five linked companions

effect: Project an astral form while the physical body and possessions remain behind; only particular multiplanar magic items accompany the projection.
Travel through the Astral Plane to reachable Outer Planes, forming a body there, or travel astrally through the Prime Material without forming a second body there.
conditions: Companions must be linked in a circle and depend on the caster; they can become stranded.
Only Astral creatures normally perceive the projection.
exceptions: Severing the silver cord kills the traveler both materially and astrally.
Astral actions do not affect creatures outside the Astral Plane; destruction of the original body or dispel magic can terminate the spell.

spells.name: Bigby'S Crushing Hand

fields.Material: Snakeskin glove and eggshell

effect: Grasp and squeeze an opponent, with constriction damage increasing as the hand continues to hold the victim.
conditions: The hand withstands damage equal to its creator's HP.
exceptions: Constriction damage: first round 1d10; second and third rounds 2d10 each; fourth and later rounds 4d10 each.

spells.name: Gate
effect: Open a connection to a named powerful being's plane and attract its attention; the source guarantees that something comes through.
conditions: Name the being whose aid is sought.
exceptions: The arrival's behavior depends on its nature, alignment, the caster's company and the opposition; the spell does not promise obedient service.

spells.name: Imprisonment
effect: Entomb the touched victim far below ground in suspended animation, beyond ordinary magical location methods.
conditions: Reverse: freedom requires the victim's name and background and returns it at the entombment site.
exceptions: Imperfect identification creates a 10% chance to free 1–100 other imprisoned creatures too.

spells.name: Meteor Swarm

fields.Saving throw: Half per burst; direct missile-path hits allow none
fields.Area: Four large or eight small meteor bursts

effect: Choose four large meteors dealing 10–40 each with 3″-diameter bursts, or eight smaller meteors dealing 5–20 each with 1½″-diameter bursts.
A creature directly in a missile's path receives its full effect without a save; otherwise save separately for each overlapping burst.
conditions: Large bursts form a box or diamond two inches per side, exposing the center to all four.
Small bursts use a box within a diamond or the reverse, with two-inch outer sides and one-inch inner sides; central areas overlap four bursts.
Projectile diameters are two feet for the large meteors and one foot for the small meteors.

spells.name: Monster Summoning VII

fields.Material: Tiny bag and small candle, inherited from monster summoning I

effect: Summon 1–2 seventh-level monsters arriving one round later, or one eighth-level monster arriving two rounds later.
conditions: Use the first summoning spell's commands and communication-dependent service rules.
exceptions: The referee selects the monsters.

spells.name: Power Word, Kill
effect: Kill either one creature with at most 60 HP, or two or more creatures each with no more than 10 HP, to a combined limit of 120 HP.
conditions: Declare single-target or multiple-target use, range and area center when casting.

spells.name: Prismatic Sphere
effect: Create a stationary, opaque seven-layer sphere protecting the caster. An intruder is exposed to every layer: the paragraph specifies 70 total damage plus possible death, petrification, insanity and planar transport.
conditions: Only the caster can pass safely; creatures below 8 HD are blinded by its colors for 2–8 turns.
Individual layers must be destroyed in consecutive order, using the appropriate counters listed in the source table.
exceptions: A rod of cancellation destroys the entire sphere.
The combined damage is not subject to saves; the final four special effects have their specified saving throws.

Layers in order: red stops nonmagical missiles and deals 10 damage, removed by cone of cold; orange stops magical missiles and deals 20, removed by gust of wind; yellow stops poison, gases and petrification and deals 40, removed by disintegrate; green stops breath weapons, save versus poison or die, removed by passwall; blue stops detection and psionics, save versus petrification or be turned to stone, removed by magic missile; indigo stops magical spells, save versus wand or become insane, removed by continual light; violet is a force field, save versus magic or be sent to another plane, removed by dispel magic.

spells.name: Shape Change

fields.Material: Jade circlet worth at least 5,000 gp

effect: Assume another creature's form, gaining its abilities except those dependent on Intelligence.
Retain the caster's own mind and current HP; each new form takes one segment and causes no system shock.
conditions: Excluded forms include demigods, greater devils, demon princes, singular dragon types, greater demons and comparable beings.
The circlet remains behind the changing caster; its premature destruction ends the spell.
exceptions: The circlet shatters at normal expiration.

spells.name: Temporal Stasis

fields.Material: Dust from one diamond, emerald, ruby and sapphire

effect: Place a creature in suspended animation, nearly halting bodily functions and preventing aging.
exceptions: Dispel magic or the reverse, temporal reinstatement, ends the state.
The reverse requires only one spoken word, without somatic or material components.

spells.name: Time Stop
effect: Stop time for everyone in the area except the caster, who can move and act freely while others are frozen.
conditions: Entering creatures also stop in time.
The caster leaving the area immediately ends the spell; outside observers see only an instant's shimmer.

spells.name: Wish
effect: Alter reality more powerfully than limited wish, subject to the exact wording and the DM's interpretation.
conditions: The listed healing, restoring a dead character or moving the party out of danger uses do not cause the spell's described disability.
Other wishes cause −3 Strength and require 2–8 days of bed rest.
exceptions: A request may be fulfilled literally in an unintended way; its wording does not guarantee the desired outcome.
